activity_summary: Coming off Errors, Kemp asked for a better door and you left him the one the play gives him. John Heminges said tomorrow's Shrew does not cast you, and that Thursday's hired men are ten shillings apiece. You did not say the Shrew would be cancelled.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a new door and said he is off tomorrow's bill.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked for a better door and did not get one.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named tomorrow's Shrew and Thursday's ten shillings apiece.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: You have left me three lines and a door. I shall require a better door.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Tomorrow is the Shrew, and you are not in it, Will.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The Shrew is the company's afternoon. I am not in it.
